senses.gloss: m. (פָּרַם) piece of cloth, rag used as a mask, bandage over the eyes. Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 19">Mishp. 19</cite> <he>פ׳ בפניהם כגון חמורים וכ׳</he> they (the demons) have a mask over their faces like the millers’ asses; <he>וכשהעונות גורמין הפ׳ נגלה וכ׳</he> and when man’s sins bring it about, the mask is removed, and man becomes insane; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 772:1">Yalk. Ps. 772</cite> <he>וכל אחד … פרמא בעיניהם וכ׳</he> (read: <he>בפני ע׳</he>) and every one of them has a bandage over his eyes; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII</cite> <he>פְּרָאמָא נתון לפני עיניהן וכ׳</he> (ed. Bub. <he>נתונה</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 670">Yalk. Ps. 670</cite> <cite ref="Q01609"><he>פרואמה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01609"><he>פרואמי׳</he></cite> (a confusion of <cite ref="Q00356"><he>פורמא</he></cite> and <cite ref="Q01540"><he>פראמא</he></cite>); Y’lamd. to Deut. II, 31, quot. in Ar. <cite ref="Q00356"><he>פורמא</he></cite> ed. Koh. (oth. ed. <cite ref="Q00247"><he>פומאריה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00247"><he>פומארים</he></cite>, corr. acc.).—Pl. <cite ref="Q00341"><he>פּוּרְמַיָּא</he></cite>, <he>פּוּרְמֵי</he>, <cite ref="Q00837"><he>פְּרָ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 79:6">Yalk. Gen. 79</cite> <he>עתיד לך פְּרוּמֵי</he> get thyself bandages (as for an ass in the tread-mill); v. <cite ref="Q00332"><he>פּוּרְבִּי</he></cite>.
